scope: Independent source/physics review of the typed Case A bundle in the selected PR97 production conditional consumer, plus v1 native test readback and v2 formatting repair.

independence.limit: Same collaborative session; decision review is separate from candidate/test authorship, not a claim of separate-laboratory replication.

v1_native_evidence.readback_integrity: Retriever record reports archive, manifests, source, binary and existing prelaunch validator pass; reviewer read raw capture/test logs and checked candidate/formatted source hashes, without rerunning build or validator.

code_physics_findings.reason: Public evaluate calls the detailed RHS; the native binary uses ConditionalSession. Its private FT03 provider feeds an owned primitive bundle that is consumed into the actual AXI source ledger.

Old aggregate thermal/escape results are not additionally consumed at this call site. Summary diagnostics come from the consumed ledger. The actual one-channel HeIII RR perturbation test passed in v1.
CI/RR/DR edge signs, electron sum, binding sum, captured kinetic cooling, primary heat and Case A escape are mutually consistent.
Primitive events/powers are proper cgs; reference photon losses multiply by a_rel^3 once; AXI converts number by 1e6 and power by 0.1. Existing geometry/work ownership is unchanged.
Public provider remains FT03. Manufactured private injection is a consumption witness, not arbitrary physical-provider admission or a new emission closure.

pending_declared_evidence: Final v2 clean-build/toolchain/binary/source identity, formatter and native test receipts.
Existing prelaunch gate and declared Decimal60 primitive gross/net/energy checks on the final binary.
Noninitial stage and one changed production interval using unchanged input bytes, solver tolerances and declared acceptance ceilings.
Final fixed claim list, evidence and source binding for scoped independent decision.
claim_limits: Existing PR97 already composed warm Case A physics; this delta is typed primitive consumption, not first physical integration.
No full owner RUX03, alternate implicit/root route completion, diffuse transport, RCT photon spectrum, cold history or cosmological physical admission.
V1 native tests do not by themselves establish final v2 production interval completion.
stop_rule: Reuse this source review after the formatting-only repair. Do not repeat source inventories, old screening or unchanged campaigns; final decision awaits already declared affected evidence.
